output.summary: A cosmopolitan genus of flowering plants, especially of alpine habitats in temperate Asia, Europe and the Americas. Gentians are remembered for mostly large, trumpet-shaped flowers, often intense blue but also yellow and other colours. Gentian root flavours bitters and other alcoholic or soft drinks.
output.edibilityNote: Gentian root flavours bitters, aperitifs, liqueurs and tonics; cooked Gentiana scabra was historically used as famine food.
